prompt: Compose one complete original 30-second instrumental promotional score. Sound: crisp breakbeat; energetic drum edits and a two-note synth hook. Instruments: chopped acoustic drums, analog synth plucks, tight bass. Tempo 136 BPM. Distinct motif: two staccato notes and an octave leap. Immediate catchy hook and clear beat at 00:00, with no slow introduction. Maintain a strong compact groove from every downbeat, suitable for a 25-second fast-montage film. Use short two-bar melodic gestures, crisp edit accents, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange and space for narration. Vary the timbre halfway through while keeping the pulse. Keep the musical hook and full groove active until the last two seconds. At 00:28, play a decisive resolving tonic button, followed by less than one second of natural decay, then end completely. No fade-out, extended outro, breakdown, long riser or silent gap. Punchy and tuneful, never harsh. Instrumental only. No vocals, choir, humming, singing, speech, lyrics or vocal samples. Do not imitate any artist, existing song or brand jingle.

description.en: An energetic and driving electronic track featuring a pulsating synth bass, punchy drums, and a catchy, uplifting synth melody. It builds in intensity with a riser before a dynamic drop.
description.zh: 一首充满活力和驱动力的电子音乐，以脉动的合成器低音、强劲的鼓点和抓耳、振奋的合成器旋律为特色。通过上升音效增强强度，随后迎来一个充满活力的爆发。
